title: German Crumble Cake
description: A classic German dessert made with a sweet crumble topping and a hint of ambrosial flavor. Perfect for a cozy evening with family and friends.

ingredients.name: ambrosial sugar
ingredients.notes: You can replace with regular sugar if ambrosial is not available

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.notes: Whole milk or low-fat milk works well

instructions: Grease a 9-inch (23cm) round cake pan and set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the ambrosial sugar, uruguayan wheat flour, and a pinch of salt.
Add the milk and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Pour the batter into the prepared cake pan.
In a separate bowl, mix the crumble topping with a bit of sugar and a pinch of salt.
Spread the crumble topping evenly over the batter.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
